options: The EDM Council
ISACA
DAMA International
The International Organization for Standardization
questions.explain: DCAM — the Data Management Capability Assessment Model — was developed by the EDM Council and is built around maturity benchmarking.

questions.q: What is COBIT primarily, and how does data governance fit into it?
options: An IT governance framework (maintained by ISACA) with data governance as one component inside a larger scope
A data-governance-only framework with no connection to IT
A regulatory law requiring data breach notification
A certification exam for data stewards
questions.explain: COBIT covers the full scope of enterprise IT governance; data governance is one piece inside that broader framework, not its sole focus.

questions.q: What makes ISO/IEC 38505 distinct from DCAM and COBIT, per the lesson?
options: It frames data governance explicitly as a board-level responsibility, operating at a higher altitude than operational frameworks
It is the only framework that includes data quality
It replaces the need for any data stewards
It is specific to a single industry only
questions.explain: ISO 38505 positions data governance as part of organizational governance — a responsibility of the governing body and senior executives, not an operational concern.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what is DCAM's main strength, and what is its tradeoff?
options: Strength: defensible maturity benchmarking. Tradeoff: assessment-heavy and less prescriptive about execution
Strength: free to implement. Tradeoff: only works for government agencies
Strength: requires no leadership buy-in. Tradeoff: incompatible with any other framework
Strength: instant certification. Tradeoff: no maturity scoring at all
questions.explain: DCAM gives a structured way to show current state vs. target state, but it doesn't prescribe exactly how to execute the fixes it identifies.

questions.q: How does the lesson say organizations commonly use these frameworks in practice?
options: They combine them — e.g., ISO 38505 for board mandate, DCAM or DMBOK for operational structure, COBIT for IT governance integration
They are legally required to pick exactly one and never deviate
Only Fortune 500 companies are permitted to use more than one
Frameworks are mutually exclusive and cannot be combined
questions.explain: The lesson describes a common practical combination where different frameworks address different layers of the same governance program.
